couplets.en: Paradise would sway with joy.
The very air would smile.

lines: Tum muskura utho to Khuda muskura uthe
couplets.en: If you were to smile, God himself would smile.
Smile for me, just once.

lines: Afsana-e-chaman ka unwan hi badal do
couplets.en: Give the garden's story another title.
Crush the heads of the flowers.
Crush the hearts of the buds.

lines: Aakash ki jawani badal mein munh chhupa le
couplets.en: Let the young sky hide its face in a cloud.
Let the moon sink.
Let sleep come to the stars.
Let the fairy with a brow like Venus weep.
Let the moon and stars look away.
What rapture there is in that swell of feeling.

lines: Hilte hue labon par hansta hua tarana dilnawaz
couplets.en: A tender tune laughs on your moving lips.

lines: Pal bhar khatir mein hai zamana
couplets.en: For a moment, the world is in your thoughts.

lines: Lab-e-mareen par bikhri hui hai lali
couplets.en: A blush lies scattered over your lips.

lines: Yeh halki halki surkhi tasveer hai shafaq ki
couplets.en: That faint flush is the image of twilight.

lines: Awara shokh zulfein rukhsar choomti hain
couplets.en: Your wayward curls kiss your cheeks.
Lost to themselves, they sway.
You are what sustains me.
You are the shore amid the waves.
Only listen, for God's sake.
Smile for me, just once.

lines: Ek naujawan musafir, fitrat ka laubali
couplets.en: There was a young traveler, carefree by nature.

lines: Ek aalam-e-junoon mein ja raha tha, jaise ke apni dhun mein
couplets.en: He went on in a kind of delirium, lost in his own thoughts.
He was climbing a mountain.
His hair was all in disarray.
His face had a weary look.
His eyes were fixed on the road.
How brokenhearted he was.

lines: Maazi ki dhund mein se ek ashk aa raha tha
couplets.en: A tear rose out of the haze of the past.

lines: Guzra hua zamana phir yaad aa raha tha
couplets.en: The days gone by were coming back to him.
His old hopes ached.
Longing stirred within him.

lines: Betaab zindagani karwat badal rahi thi
couplets.en: His restless life kept turning from side to side.
The poor soul kept counting stars.
He found no rest, and his heart grew uneasy.

lines: Dekh to kya hai, kaun basa hai ji ke ghar mein
couplets.en: Look and see who has made a home in your heart.
Look in those lowered eyes.

lines: Dil mein, aankh mein, dil mein
couplets.en: Look in the heart, then the eyes, then the heart again.

lines: Dil ko jalana khel na jana
couplets.en: Do not make a game of setting a heart alight.
Once you kindle that fire in a heart, it will spread.
You too will burn.
You will wring your hands.
You are the candle that lights the gathering.

lines: Khud bhi jalo, jala do, lekin
couplets.en: You can burn and kindle that flame in others.
Smile for me, just once.
You are at the heart of all I mean to say.
You have a beauty that steals the heart.
How much more can I say?

lines: Meri hi is ghazal ka rangeen qafiya ho
couplets.en: You are the bright rhyme of this ghazal of mine.
May I ask you something?
Tell me, will you answer?

lines: Yeh husn, yeh jawani, sarkar kya karogi
couplets.en: My dear, what will you do with all this beauty and youth?

lines: Honton ki muskurahat becho, khareed loongi
couplets.en: Sell me the smile on your lips and I will buy it.
Say the word if you agree.
I will pay more than you can name.
But smile for me, just once.
